sentences.en: We must do everything we can to stimulate the economy.
sentences.zh: 我们必须尽一切可能刺激经济。

sentences.en: Algeria is spending billions of dollars to stimulate its economy.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚正在投入数十亿美元来刺激其经济增长。

sentences.en: This is moderately spicy, but it does stimulate the appetite.
sentences.zh: 这辣度适中，但确实能增进食欲。

senses.zh: 起刺激作用；起促进作用
